radio.title: Ideas of beauty
radio.text: What people find beautiful may differ from one culture to another and from one century to the next. It could be argued that some things, such as symmetrical faces or a view of water, are attractive almost everywhere. However, fashion and advertising can also shape our ideas. Some researchers believe that images edited by computer should be labelled, because they might make young people unhappy with how they look.
